frases.dice: Fine-tuning a sixty-five billion parameter model in sixteen-bit needs more than seven hundred eighty gigabytes of GPU memory.
frases.muestra: Fine-tuning a 65-billion-parameter model in 16-bit needs more than 780 GB of GPU memory.
frases.es: Ajustar un modelo de 65.000 millones de parámetros en 16 bits necesita más de 780 GB de memoria de GPU.

frases.dice: With Q Lora, less than forty-eight: a single GPU.
frases.muestra: With QLoRA, less than 48: a single GPU.
frases.es: Con QLoRA, menos de 48: una sola GPU.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and model merging.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and model merging.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: ajuste eficiente (PEFT) y fusión de modelos.

frases.dice: The idea behind Lora is simple: freeze the original weights, and learn only a small correction.
frases.muestra: The idea behind LoRA is simple: freeze the original weights, and learn only a small correction.
frases.es: La idea de LoRA es simple: congelas los pesos originales y aprendes solo una corrección pequeña.

frases.dice: That correction is the product of two thin matrices, B times A, with rank r. Instead of d times k parameters, you train r times d plus k.
frases.muestra: That correction is the product of two thin matrices, B·A, with rank r. Instead of d·k parameters, you train r·(d + k).
frases.es: Esa corrección es el producto de dos matrices delgadas, B·A, de rango r. En vez de d·k parámetros, entrenas r·(d + k).

frases.dice: For a four thousand ninety-six by four thousand ninety-six layer with rank eight: sixty-five thousand parameters instead of seventeen million. Zero point four percent.
frases.muestra: For a 4096 × 4096 layer with rank 8: 65,536 parameters instead of 16.8 million. 0.39%.
frases.es: Con una capa de 4096 × 4096 y rango 8: 65.536 parámetros en vez de 16,8 millones. El 0,39%.

frases.dice: Why is such a low rank enough? Because the change a model needs for a new task concentrates almost all its energy in a few directions.
frases.muestra: Why is such a low rank enough? Because the change a model needs for a new task concentrates almost all its energy in a few directions.
frases.es: ¿Por qué basta un rango tan bajo? Porque el cambio que necesita el modelo para una tarea nueva concentra casi toda su energía en pocas direcciones.

frases.dice: On GPT-3, Lora trained ten thousand times fewer parameters, with three times less memory. And when you're done, you add B times A into the weights: zero extra latency.
frases.muestra: On GPT-3, LoRA trained 10,000× fewer parameters, with 3× less memory. When done, you add B·A into the weights: zero extra latency.
frases.es: En GPT-3, LoRA entrenó 10.000 veces menos parámetros, con 3 veces menos memoria. Y al terminar, sumas B·A a los pesos: cero latencia extra.

frases.dice: Q Lora goes further: it stores the frozen model in four bits, with a format called NormalFloat four, and trains Lora adapters on top.
frases.muestra: QLoRA goes further: it stores the frozen model in 4 bits, with a format called NormalFloat 4, and trains LoRA adapters on top.
frases.es: QLoRA va más allá: guarda el modelo congelado en 4 bits, con un formato llamado NormalFloat 4, y entrena los adaptadores LoRA encima.

frases.dice: It also quantizes the quantization constants themselves, saving zero point three seven bits per parameter, and pages the optimizer to avoid memory spikes.
frases.muestra: It also quantizes the quantization constants themselves, saving 0.37 bits per parameter, and pages the optimizer to avoid memory spikes.
frases.es: Además, cuantiza las propias constantes de cuantización (ahorra 0,37 bits por parámetro) y pagina el optimizador para evitar picos de memoria.

frases.dice: Dora splits each weight into magnitude and direction. It applies Lora only to the direction, and trains the magnitude separately. At the same rank, it usually gets closer to full fine-tuning.
frases.muestra: DoRA splits each weight into magnitude and direction: LoRA on the direction only, magnitude trained separately. At the same rank, it usually gets closer to full fine-tuning.
frases.es: DoRA separa cada peso en magnitud y dirección: aplica LoRA solo a la dirección y entrena la magnitud aparte. Con el mismo rango, suele acercarse más al ajuste completo.

frases.dice: Now, model merging. Subtract the base model from a fine-tuned model, and you get a task vector: what fine-tuning changed.
frases.muestra: Now, model merging. Subtract the base model from a fine-tuned model, and you get a task vector: what fine-tuning changed.
frases.es: Ahora, fusionar modelos. Si restas el modelo base al modelo ajustado, obtienes un vector de tarea: lo que el ajuste cambió.

frases.dice: Add task vectors from several tasks to the base, and you combine skills without retraining.
frases.muestra: Add task vectors from several tasks to the base, and you combine skills without retraining.
frases.es: Sumando vectores de varias tareas a la base, combinas habilidades sin volver a entrenar.

frases.dice: But averaging in a straight line has a problem: between two perpendicular vectors of length one, the midpoint is only zero point seven long.
frases.muestra: But averaging in a straight line has a problem: between two perpendicular unit vectors, the midpoint is only 0.71 long.
frases.es: Pero promediar en línea recta tiene un problema: entre dos vectores perpendiculares de largo 1, el punto medio mide solo 0,71.

frases.dice: SLERP interpolates along the arc of the sphere, and keeps the length. That's why it's a common way to blend two models.
frases.muestra: SLERP interpolates along the arc of the sphere and keeps the length. That's why it's a common way to blend two models.
frases.es: SLERP interpola por el arco de la esfera y conserva el largo. Por eso es una forma común de mezclar dos modelos.

frases.dice: With more than two models, TIES resolves conflicts in three steps. Trim: keep only the top twenty percent of changes. Elect one sign per parameter. And average only the values that agree with it.
frases.muestra: With more than two models, TIES resolves conflicts in three steps: trim (keep the top 20% of changes), elect one sign per parameter, and average only the values that agree.
frases.es: Con más de dos modelos, TIES resuelve los choques en tres pasos: recorta (deja el 20% de cambios más grandes), elige un signo por parámetro y promedia solo los que coinciden.

frases.dice: If three models change a parameter by plus zero point five, plus zero point three, and minus zero point six, a plain average almost cancels it: zero point zero seven. TIES gives zero point four.
frases.muestra: If three models change a parameter by +0.5, +0.3 and −0.6, a plain average almost cancels it: 0.07. TIES gives 0.4.
frases.es: Si tres modelos cambian un parámetro en +0,5, +0,3 y −0,6, el promedio simple casi lo anula: 0,07. TIES da 0,4.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, Vertex AI offers supervised tuning, and open models like Gemma to adapt with Lora. And a machine with one L4 GPU, which has twenty-four gigabytes, is enough for Q Lora on a seven billion parameter model.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, Vertex AI offers supervised tuning and open models like Gemma to adapt with LoRA. One 24 GB L4 GPU is enough for QLoRA on a 7B model.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, Vertex AI ofrece ajuste supervisado y modelos abiertos como Gemma para adaptar con LoRA. Y una máquina con una GPU L4 de 24 GB alcanza para QLoRA sobre un modelo de 7.000 millones.

frases.dice: Now you have the basics. Lora learns a low-rank correction. Q Lora trains it on a four-bit model. And for merging, SLERP keeps the length, and TIES stops signs from cancelling out.
frases.muestra: The basics: LoRA learns a low-rank correction. QLoRA trains it on a 4-bit model. For merging, SLERP keeps the length and TIES stops signs from cancelling out.
frases.es: Con esto tienes las bases: LoRA aprende una corrección de bajo rango; QLoRA la entrena sobre un modelo en 4 bits; y para fusionar, SLERP conserva el largo y TIES evita que los signos se anulen.
